requirements.desc: R1: spec JSON schema defines 11 fields
requirements.note: Added `src/flow/schemas/spec.schema.json` with all 11 required top-level fields and typed nested structures (`scope`, `overview`, etc.).

requirements.desc: R2: spec render auto-resolves active flow spec.json
requirements.note: `src/spec/commands/render.js` resolves active flow spec dir via flow state, reads `spec.json`, and defaults output to sibling `spec.md`.
Renderer is deterministic for fixed inputs and unit test asserts byte-identical output on repeated render calls.

requirements.desc: R4: schema validator reports missing required fields
requirements.note: Schema marks all required fields, and tests verify missing-field errors, but tests only sample a subset of required fields rather than all 11.

requirements.desc: R5: sample spec.json for 196 renders successfully
requirements.note: Added `specs/196-spec-json-schema-render/spec.json` and rendered `spec.md` artifact for the same spec.

requirements.desc: R6: interface.md documents all spec.md I/O sites
requirements.note: Added `specs/196-spec-json-schema-render/interface.md` with per-file `spec.md` I/O inventory, touched fields/sections, and T8 migration approach.

requirements.desc: R7: existing test suite passes without regression
requirements.note: Diff includes claims of full pass in `issue-log.json`, but `flow.json` test summary only shows unit scope; direct full-suite evidence is not clearly captured in executable artifacts.

requirements.desc: R8: rendered spec.md section order matches init skeleton
requirements.note: Renderer and tests preserve existing skeleton heading relative order while allowing added sections (Background/Constraints/Design Principles/Overview).
